newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures rally runs out of steam.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures rally runs out of steam.

text.p: UK grain futures failed to sustain Monday's rally on Tuesday as players took stock of recent developments.

"Some people got over-excited on Monday on the news of the Franch sale of 450,000 tonnes of wheat to Egypt. But in the cold light of day they now realise that it will all come from French stocks and has nothing to do with this market," said a trader.

Traders said news of the sale had boosted the French market and gave UK grain a bit of head room, but ...."the Franch market didn't go as high as people expected and that has limited this market's room to manoeuvre," said one.
UK wheat futures closed 0.80 to 0.90 stg down after trading 347 lots while barley was 0.50 to 0.15 stg lower on a turnover of 22 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
UK cash trading was slow with no business reported in the fob sector while the delivered market was just "ticking over", traders said.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 127.50 stg for September in Southampton while 126 stg was paid for Oct/Dec material in London.
September feed wheat was fatching 107 stg in most parts of the country while between 108 and 110.50 stg was be paid for Oct/Dec.
Feed barley traded at 105.50 stg for Oct/Dec in most areas.
